name: Import
description: Importers that read the vector formats export writes, its inverse: the contract for an SVG document read into one scene and a Lottie JSON document read into a document, with byte, element, layer and depth caps, a typed ImportError and an ImportReport listing what was skipped; SVGPathData, which reads SVG path data (every command, absolute and relative, arcs as cubics) into a Path; and XMLTokens, the bounded, Linux-safe XML tokenizer the SVG reader walks (tags, attributes, text, entities; comments, declarations and CDATA skipped). The Lottie reader turns shape and solid layers, their paths, rectangles, ellipses, fills, strokes, gradients and transforms into one scene, with keyframes (easings from the file's handles, holds) as position, scale, rotation, opacity, colour, stroke width and shape tracks, masks as layer masks and tt as track mattes, counting parents, expressions, keyed anchors and group transforms and other layer kinds as skipped; the SVG document reader turns basic shapes and paths, with their transforms baked in and solid fills and strokes from attributes and style, into one scene, one layer per top-level drawable, counting every other element as skipped.

relationships.description: builds scenes, layers, shapes and fills
